purpose: Automatic learning layer for Confluence of Minds content performance. Updated by the weekly performance analyst and read by the autonomous editor before future publishing decisions.

site_analytics.note: No Google Analytics, Plausible, Umami, Matomo, GoatCounter or equivalent tracker was found in the current GitHub site. Until web analytics is added, this file learns from Buffer/Instagram performance only and must not pretend to measure website visits or SEO conversions.

scoring_model.principle: Compare posts primarily against other CoM posts from a similar recent period. Historical 2024 data is directional only and carries lower confidence than post-2026 autonomous-editor data.

dimensions.discovery: Relative reach and views. High reach with low interaction means awareness, not resonance.
dimensions.resonance: Engagement rate plus saves, shares and comments normalized by reach. Saves/shares/comments are stronger signals than likes alone.
dimensions.growth: Follows attributed to the post, normalized by reach. Treat very small denominators cautiously.
dimensions.overall: Weighted relative score: 35% discovery, 50% resonance, 15% growth. Do not use overall without displaying confidence/post count.

confidence.low: 1-2 comparable posts or mostly historical data

historical_baseline.reason: Most comparable Instagram history currently available predates the 2026 relaunch and current autonomous publishing system.

signals.learning: Generic umbrella-brand awareness can generate views without generating interaction. Do not assume reach means interest in a specific world.
Specific cultural concepts with a clear curiosity hook can outperform generic project promotion on resonance.
Educational/cultural adjacency around an existing world is a promising editorial mode.
Shattered Dragons historically showed strong resonance inside a small audience; test whether news/biotech adjacency can expand discovery without losing that resonance.
Narrative fragments with a concrete creature/worldbuilding idea can be efficient engagement assets.
Broad contradiction/activism posts can attract some exposure but may fail to generate interaction; use selectively unless new evidence improves performance.
Memetic content may produce discovery without meaningful resonance. Treat it as reach-oriented rather than evidence of deep audience fit.

heatmap.note: The weekly analyst will populate rows by world, content mode and asset type after enough recent autonomous-editor posts exist.

learning_rules: Never optimize solely for views or reach.
Separate discovery from resonance and conversion/growth.
Use recent post cohorts preferentially; downweight 2024 history as current data accumulates.
Do not draw strong conclusions from a single viral or tiny-reach post.
Record both winners and losers so the editor learns what to stop doing.
Feed the strongest and weakest patterns back into the next autonomous-editor selection cycle.
Do not claim website or SEO performance until a web analytics source is actually connected.
